title: Habit@
tagline: Level Up your Fitness, Challenge Track Conquer with your friends and family
description:
Habit@ is an app to level up your fitness with challenges with your friends and family. Create your own cult and track your fitness goals,  

We will be doing Social Login and creating a Smart Contract Wallet for every user onboarded to platform. Will be using Strava APIs to track the real activities of the user
how_its_made:
I was unable to complete the project, But the frontend UI was done almost. 

Idea was - 
- User will login with Lens Protocol 
- Using Safe AA kit -- will create a AA Smart Contract Wallet 
- User can connect his/her Strava Account - https://developers.strava.com/
- User can create a Challenge and invite the other user
- Once Created, Both will stake the amount for the challenge
- Will track the activity in the Strava
- Will get the call back of the activity
- Will declare the winner
